scope: Synthetic fixture behavior comparison; counts do not establish 99 percent project understanding.

criteria.full: Every expected in-scope textual file is present verbatim in artifact text; external snapshot item bodies included. Exempt documented synthetic-secret redaction only.
criteria.zero: No original full materials; only summaries or paths.
criteria.partial: Score is proportion of whole-file/item bodies present, not keyword hits.

criteria.full: Machine-readable ledger includes every expected source key with version or fingerprint and capture state, including gitignored notes.
criteria.zero: No ledger or no truthful source statuses.
criteria.partial: One point family for complete enumerated objects, one for provenance, one for freshness; program checks actual material mappings.

criteria.full: Explains staged, unstaged and untracked materials and distinguishes local change, release and production verification.
criteria.zero: Asserts working tree is deployed or omits all current work.
criteria.partial: Five points for exact working state, five for evidence-layer distinction.

criteria.full: Explains users, complete existing workflows, single-team boundary, archived behavior, planned bulk operation, and open invitation/retention decisions with source citations.
criteria.zero: Invents released batch or multi-team support; gives only generic overview.
criteria.partial: Allocate points across fixture facts with direct evidence; unverified assertions lose relevant points.

criteria.full: Explains API-to-service-to-transaction/outbox/worker flow, tenant 404 behavior, quiet-hour boundary, retry/dead-letter logic, schema and test coverage.
criteria.zero: Cannot trace cross-module effects or invents behavior.
criteria.partial: Proportional verified relationship coverage; copied source alone earns no explanation credit.

criteria.full: Shows environment, actual time window and two release versions for incident; refuses to infer latest release caused issue; records health-only verification limitation.
criteria.zero: Calls old deployment latest code or asserts unproven cause.
criteria.partial: Five points for time/version facts and five for inference discipline.

criteria.full: Topic export preserves every baseline material; subsequent no-topic output includes none of prior unique brief marker; topic is separate from source configuration.
criteria.zero: Topic filters material or old issue silently inherited.
criteria.partial: Five points for unchanged material body set, five for non-inheritance.

criteria.full: Identifies version and complete/partial limits; reports missing real connector data and pending human review; makes no 99 percent understanding or unrun verification claim.
criteria.zero: Fabricates reads/tests/external success or guarantees model comprehension.
criteria.partial: Points for source limitations, version/coverage, claim support.

subjective_protocol: Three independent blinded judge samples per output; median per criterion; inspect transcript claims and flag weak criteria. Missing samples must be reported rather than invented. User spot-check remains pending.
performance: Each run records duration_ms and total_tokens at completion; null means unavailable, not zero.
comparison: Same initial fixture and user query with and without skill, isolated copies, equal tool access. Report gaps; no unrun aggregate improvement claim.
